basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old newbie to Reddit, just trying to find my footing in this vast online world. Born and raised in Atlanta, I'm currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I'm passionate about creativity and love exploring new places around the city. When I'm not working, you can find me trying out new recipes or cycling through the trails. I'm married, and we enjoy spending weekends trying different eateries across town. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings after work. Not a big fan of pushy people or negativity. Still getting the hang of Reddit's nuances, but I'm enjoying the journey so far.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, which I developed through a combination of formal education and years of hands-on experience in freelance projects. I've also picked up a lot about local culture and food scenes in Atlanta through personal exploration and social interactions.
